scenario.label: media consensus heavy
scenario.whenToUse: When latest mock drafts are stable and team-specific data is weak.
scenario.risk: Misses team-specific reaches or late-breaking moves.

prospectBigBoard.top60Or100Status: Could not stably extract top 60/100. ESPN Big Board exposed 25; ESPN final mock local raw exposed first-round top 30 only.

policy.official_data_rule: Treat as read-only official/user-provided source material.
policy.external_policy: Use NBA.com official pages first; use major media as weighted signals; ignore social/self-media for model input.

sourceRisks: Official NBA.com prospects reconciliation completed; all 30 final candidates are present on the official Prospects page.
